useWhen: An operator hands over a bank or card statement they downloaded (OFX/QFX/QBO, 全銀 data, freee, MoneyForward, Xero or QuickBooks Online statement CSV, a bank or card CSV) or a Ramp, Brex, Expensify or BILL export, with or without a kaikei ledger, and asks whether the books agree with the bank, which invoices were paid, what each line should be posted as, or to post the lines they approve
avoidWhen: Connecting to a bank, card issuer or expense or AP service, account aggregation, making or scheduling payments, posting lines the operator has not approved, choosing a consumption-tax rate kaikei reports as unknown, claiming 電子帳簿保存法 compliance or filing taxes; handling real statements on a remote inference rail without the operator's consent

inputs.text: statement or expense export the operator provided
inputs.ledger: the operator's kaikei ledger, when the statement belongs to one
inputs.approvals: the lines the operator approved, each with the choice they accepted

outputs.checks: per-account open lines, statement against ledger balance and the first running-balance break
outputs.candidates: invoice settlements, matches, transfers and rule suggestions with strength and reasons
outputs.ledger: the ledger with the approved lines posted, and the skipped lines with reasons
outputs.aging: receivable and payable aging in 30-day buckets

authority.binding: caller authorization; the mcp server must be enabled in the profile by its owner

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-23: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. The steps call MCP tools by their itonami-agent names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and assume the server key in mcp_servers matches the entry id.
